findings.title: Dead layout modules remain in coverage totals
findings.why_it_matters: The configuration now describes coverage as scoped to production-reachable modules, but its broad collection pattern still instruments both unreachable AutoLayout implementations at 0%. Aggregate coverage reports therefore mix live and dead code, contradicting the stated boundary and leaving future maintainers unsure whether to test, delete, or ignore those modules.
findings.suggested_fix: Add explicit collectCoverageFrom exclusions for src/utils/AutoLayout.ts and src/utils/AutoLayoutEnhanced.ts, then rerun the coverage suite to verify the six per-file thresholds and live-code aggregate.
evidence: jest.config.js:37 still collects src/**/*.ts; the only exclusions at lines 38-39 cover declarations and test-example.ts.

jest.config.js:44-45 says legacy AutoLayout has no production imports and is not counted as live coverage, but the generated LCOV report contains src/utils/AutoLayout.ts and src/utils/AutoLayoutEnhanced.ts at 0%.
A repository import search finds no production imports of either src/utils/AutoLayout.ts or src/utils/AutoLayoutEnhanced.ts.

findings.title: Empty matcher hides the directory assertion
findings.why_it_matters: toMatchObject({}) accepts every resolved stat object, so the assertion communicates no property of the created path. A maintainer has to infer that merely resolving is intended, and the test does not explicitly preserve the stronger behavior that listBpmnFiles creates a directory rather than some other filesystem entry.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the empty-object matcher with expect((await fs.stat(nestedRoot)).isDirectory()).toBe(true).
evidence: tests/unit/utils/FileManager.test.ts:110 asserts fs.stat(nestedRoot) resolves toMatchObject({}); an empty partial object matches any resolved Stats value.
The test name and preceding call at lines 107-109 imply that directory creation is the contract being exercised, but isDirectory() is never checked.

residual_risks: The new LayoutEngine cases partially overlap topology and pool-direction coverage in tests/unit/core/LayoutModel.test.ts; the new assertions add distinct disconnected-component, rank-order, and pool-separation contracts, so the overlap is not strong enough to recommend removal in this pass.
